exclusions.reason: Brune, Daendels, Suvorov, Thugut, Archduke Charles, Kleber, and Nelson serve the strategic narrative; no separate subject was created unless their action is necessary access to a major campaign or settlement.

exclusions.label: Passing references to revolutionary precedents and anniversaries
exclusions.reason: Robespierre, Babeuf, Year II, 1793, Fructidor, Thermidor, and earlier constitutional episodes are analogies or background unless incorporated into a discovered analytical subject.

exclusions.reason: Places such as Dax, Agen, Genoa, Lombardy, Liguria, Venetia, Ceylon, Trinidad, and the Cape are evidence within broader military or diplomatic treatments, not all separate expected subjects.
